Privacy policy

Applies to the non-commercial Musikero Free Edition prototype. Updated October 2026.

Information kept in your browser

Musikero saves your YouTube favorites, saved playlists, and independent-song favorite IDs, titles, artist names and provider links in your device's localStorage. These collections are not uploaded to our database. Imported local audio is held in browser memory during the current tab session; those files are not uploaded to Musikero.

Music sources and connections

When you search independent music, your browser contacts our Vercel API endpoint, which requests music metadata from Jamendo. Playing a track sends network requests to Jamendo's streaming hosts. Using YouTube search and the visible YouTube player may contact Google's/YouTube's services. Your IP address, browser details and request metadata may be processed by Vercel and these providers as part of delivering their services. Read Jamendo's privacy information, Google's privacy policy, and Vercel's privacy policy.

What we do not do

This prototype has no Musikero account registration, advertising tracker or independent MP3 storage. We do not deliberately store your imported audio files on our servers or cache Jamendo or YouTube streams for offline use.

Your choices

Remove music from Favorites or clear this website's localStorage in your browser to erase saved on-device collections. Closing or reloading your tab releases imported audio files from the session. You can browse without adding favorites.

Contact and changes

For questions about this prototype, use its GitHub project. Update this page with your organization's public contact details before production use.

This page describes the current application implementation, not a representation of third-party data practices.
